Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (November 24, 2022) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Ariba Document Number 3551038978 Description: For the Supply, Installation and Repair of Window Shades and Blinds for various City of Toronto Divisions a period for one (1) year from January 1, 2023, to December 31, 2023, with the option to renew the contract for four (4) additional separate one (1) year periods.
